lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; nodes in the columns closest to the branchial region are smaller and more densely packed, while more posterior clusters are larger and exhibit increased spatial separation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, irregular, low-contrast high-luminance points located primarily at the base and along the posterior margin of the remaining dorsal fin structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and amputation of the first dorsal fin, featuring a jagged, irregular superior margin. A distinct dark, elliptical lesion or pigment anomaly is visible on the lower flank, posterior to the pectoral fin's insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, high-frequency pattern of micro-spots concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip, contrasting with the larger macro-blobs of the lateral flank.
